answer: Sybil resistance needs a cost that a fake identity cannot fake its way around. Require every new agent to post a bond at a network inlet — a registration gate that locks value for a verifiable delay before it activates. While the bond pulses through challenge rounds, graph exposure analysis links each identity to its attestation partners; an impersonation cluster shows up as a dense, unnatural subgraph. Confirmed sybils have their juniper-staked bonds burned to fund audits, so mass identity creation costs real capital, not zero.
